routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's title/content/color/labels/reminder; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
archive or unarchive a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin or unpin a note (defaults to pinned: true); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
permanently delete a note from the Trash view; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
empty the trash; returns 200 with the removed count

notes: REQ-2.8.1 (Pin note) extends the pin flow built on REQ-2.2: the note card already carries a 'Pin' button (aria-label 'Pin', visible on card hover) that POSTs /api/notes/:id/pin, and render() already splits the notes view into the 'Pinned' and 'Others' sections, so the acceptance scenario (hover the note, click Pin, then see /pinned/i heading plus the note title) works with the existing frontend and the existing POST /api/notes/:id/pin route (defaults pinned: true; 404 on unknown id). The only missing piece is the fixture: the requirement states the system contains a regular (unpinned) note titled 'Meeting agenda 2.8.1', which must be seeded in backend/data/db.json (pinned: false, not archived, not deleted) so it is reproduced on every fresh start and is hoverable on the home page. The new seed row is additive and does not alter any route, page structure, or existing seed data, so all previously implemented requirements (REQ-1.1 through REQ-2.7.x) are unaffected.
